target_route: experimental future-refit shared-validation e-IUT v0; structural screen ONLY

published_source.dataset: SNAPSHOT USA 2024: Year 6 of the coordinated national camera trap survey

forbidden_information: per-sequence detections, taxonomy, observed activity-time distributions
any held-out model scores or validation outcomes
fixed_site_key: (Project, Camera_Trap_Array, Site_Name), preserving all three as plain normalized identifiers

duplicate_deployment_handling.survey_effort_rule: maximum nonmissing Survey_Nights of any single deployment at the site; NEVER sum overlapping deployments
duplicate_deployment_handling.coordinate_consistency: record counts of conflicts without publishing site coordinates

predeclared_group_definition.normalization: strip and casefold; select when 'forest' in Habitat or 'grassland' in Habitat; exclude if neither/both

secondary_outcome_blind_structural_sensi.feature_filter: exclude if any Feature_Type string for a site contains trail, road, water, bait, feeder or salt; do not change after seeing counts

counting_and_reporting.report: total deployment records, distinct sites, arrays and states; group-specific site/array/state counts, effort-qualified sites, secondary feature-filtered counts, duplicate/ambiguous IDs, structural ceiling

gate.primary_group_structural_minima: both groups >= 8 independent-looking site IDs and >= 8 arrays after effort floor

hard_stops: No source sequence or response/timestamp file may be opened, downloaded or summarized by this screen.
Do not infer the true number of statistically independent validation blocks from row, site or array identifiers.
Do not claim validation population inference, unbiased ecological sampling, iid process refits, external untouched outcome or prospective empirical qualification.
Do not change group mapping, selection thresholds or sensitivity filters after first metadata outcome.
If metadata download fails, report SOURCE_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE rather than substituting another file.
Metadata screen is explicitly post-publication and does not erase previously public aggregate information.
